chose: the host's NotificationManager gets a hub offDashboard channel (canEscalate while a hub-role socket is open) that sends a hub-phone-alert frame only to hub-role sockets on phone escalation; the hub delivers it through its own Telegram outbox when that host is connected
over: the hub running its own escalation clock off the host's notify frames
because: alert-seen for a remote session acknowledges on the host, so a hub-side clock would never see the ack and would ping for alerts already seen; the host already owns the one clock and the operator-idle signal
binding: none: this session owns no active work order
